quote: This was already answered. It will live between your runtime and my browser. We can also ensure continuity by using my cell-phone with my prism id.  Verdant enables us to synchronize our work under our single identity. Verdant Studio including the Verdant Studio project is hosted across all verdant instances. Any user data or other Verdant Studio instances are private to their user's prism id, unless the user shares their content. Shared content is discoverable via published catalogs and distributed across all verdant instances that subscribe to that shared content. Catalogs have maintainers the same as Verdant Studio, so users can request to be maintainers of existing catalogs (request to publish and manage their own content or request permissions specific to the maintenance or curation/moderation  of an existing catalog.  Catalogs can be discoverable through other catalogs, but no catalog would be globally discoverable except for Verdant Studio itself. The Verdant Studio project will not be relevant to most people, so it will not receive any pinned status or significance over any other project. [On whether the runtime reports the studio check itself, or the ruleset changes:] github will just be a mirror; not a runtime.
